content_zh:
在第二次十八岁生日这一天，陈冲做了一个梦。
梦里的空间上下四周都是无垠星穹，他就站在星海当中，面前是一口六角古井。
他低头往下望去，井中，一双猩红的眼睛忽然出现。
下一刻。
古井化为囊括星空的巨口，将他、将梦、将这一切全部吞噬。
陈冲猛地睁开眼睛。
视野中仍是自己那间狭小卧室的天花板。
没有什么巨兽与星空，日光灯管后的飞虫黑点不断闪烁。
“噩梦……吗？”
陈冲皱了皱眉。
刚刚的梦境有些异样的真实，似乎和平时的不一样。
但对这一个格外清晰的噩梦，他又没有分毫受到惊吓的感觉。
有一点奇异。
出神片刻，陈冲歪头，看向床头柜上的老旧机械闹钟，时针已经指向了“12”。
“睡这么久？”
他挑了挑眉，起身披衣，推开房门，客厅里电视的声音顿时放大了。
“……希望集团昨日宣布，其旗下‘曙光生物’公司已经再度突破了基因编辑技术的限制，未来十年，中心城的人均预期寿命有望突破一百大关……”
“……利山市治安局通报，近日发生多起传呼机诈骗案件。犯罪团伙利用传呼机信息假冒办案人员，诱骗受害者去银行转账，或是前往市外的聚居地参与调查、兑奖等等活动，而后实施绑架勒索。治安局提醒广大市民注意甄别，勿要轻信犯罪分子的话术，任何前往市外荒原的活动均为诈骗滋滋——”
正在播报新闻的老电视突然变成一片雪花，姑父沈建平皱起眉头低骂了一句，从深红色的人造皮沙发上起来，走到电视机前，对着老电视的大机箱狠狠拍了两巴掌。
“砰、砰——”

“现在播报下一则简讯……”
两声大响治好了电视，也把正在厨房备菜的姑姑惊了一跳，探出头嗔怪道
“给你说了好多次，让你轻点，别给拍坏了——冲儿，你起来啦？先洗把脸，午饭马上就好。”
姑姑陈丽萍温和的笑了笑，她面颊微胖，皮肤白净，虽然长相普通，但看上去很亲切。只不过眼角密集的细纹和两鬓的几缕灰发显出了些年纪。
陈冲点了点头
“不知道怎么睡到这么晚。”
“没事，都放寒假了，年轻人就该多睡会儿，长身体。”
陈丽萍说完就缩回厨房去，厨房里立马传出来炒菜的声音。
不过十来分钟。
陈冲刚洗漱妥当，陈丽萍就将最后一道大菜，一盆红烧鲤鱼放在大圆饭桌的正中，招呼一家人吃饭。
“老沈！”
“来了。”
沈建平先拿起遥控板，将电视的声音调大，然后才离开沙发，走到一间卧室门口推开门
“沈冬，关门干什么？吃——”
沈建平的声音突然顿了一下，又将门默默拉上。
门里传来表弟沈冬慌乱的声音
“来、马上来了！”
沈建平表情古怪的站了几秒，才挪到另外一个卧室，轻轻的敲门，声音也变得温和
“颖儿，饭做好了，出来吃吧？”
门啪的一声打开，表妹沈颖面无表情的走出，自顾自走到饭桌旁边坐下。
content_en:
On his second eighteenth birthday, Chen Chong had a dream.
The space in the dream was surrounded by endless stars. He was standing in the sea of ​​stars, with a hexagonal ancient well in front of him.
He lowered his head and looked down. In the well, a pair of scarlet eyes suddenly appeared.
The next moment.
The ancient well turned into a huge mouth that encompassed the starry sky, swallowing him, Jiang Meng, and everything else.
Chen Chong opened his eyes suddenly.
The ceiling of his small bedroom was still in his field of vision.
There are no giant beasts or stars in the sky, and the black spots of flying insects behind the fluorescent tubes are constantly flashing.
"Nightmare...?"
Chen Chong frowned.
The dream just now seemed strangely real, and seemed different from usual ones.
But he didn't feel frightened at all by this particularly clear nightmare.
A little strange.
After being lost in thought for a moment, Chen Chong tilted his head and looked at the old mechanical alarm clock on the bedside table. The hour hand was already pointing to "12".
"Sleeping for so long?"
He raised his eyebrows, stood up, put on his clothes, and opened the door. The sound of the TV in the living room suddenly became louder.
"...Hope Group announced yesterday that its subsidiary company Dawn Biotechnology has once again broken through the limitations of gene editing technology. In the next ten years, the average life expectancy in Central City is expected to exceed the 100 mark..."
"...Lishan City Public Security Bureau reported that many pager fraud cases have occurred recently. Criminal gangs use pager information to impersonate case investigators, tricking victims into making bank transfers, or going to settlements outside the city to participate in investigations, prize redemptions, and other activities, and then carry out kidnapping and extortion. The Public Security Bureau reminds the general public to pay attention to screening and not to believe the words of criminals. Any activities going to the wilderness outside the city are scams - "
The old TV that was broadcasting the news suddenly turned into a snowflake. Uncle Shen Jianping frowned and cursed, got up from the dark red artificial leather sofa, walked to the TV, and slapped the big box of the old TV twice.
"Bang, bang——"
"Now for the next briefing..."
Two loud noises cured the TV, and also startled my aunt who was preparing food in the kitchen. She stuck her head out and said:
"I've told you many times to be gentle and don't get damaged - Chong'er, are you up? Wash your face first, lunch will be ready soon."
Aunt Chen Liping smiled gently. She had chubby cheeks and fair skin. Although she looked ordinary, she looked very kind. But the dense fine lines at the corners of his eyes and the few strands of gray hair on his temples showed his age.
Chen Chong nodded.
"I don't know why I stayed up so late."
"It's okay. It's winter vacation. Young people should sleep more and grow stronger."
After Chen Liping finished speaking, she retreated to the kitchen, and the sound of cooking could be heard immediately in the kitchen.
Only about ten minutes.
As soon as Chen Chong had washed up, Chen Liping placed the last dish, a pot of braised carp, in the middle of the large round dining table and invited the family to eat.
"Old Shen!"
"Coming."
Shen Jianping first picked up the remote control panel and turned up the TV volume, then left the sofa and walked to the door of a bedroom and opened the door.
"Shen Dong, why are you closing the door? Eat——"
Shen Jianping's voice suddenly paused, and he silently closed the door again.
Cousin Shen Dong's panicked voice came from the door.
"Come on, it's coming soon!"
Shen Jianping stood there with a strange expression for a few seconds before moving to another bedroom and knocking on the door gently, his voice becoming gentle.
"Ying'er, the meal is ready, why don't you come out to eat?"
The door opened with a bang, and cousin Shen Ying walked out expressionlessly, walking to the dining table and sitting down.
